item.title: TableGrip 1.0.0-beta.5
item.description: ### ✨ Features - Adjust ConnectionDialog size and improve driver selection layout - Implement password prompt for connections and add SSL options - Added functionality to navigate to the last page in TableDataTab - Website downloads follow the newest release in the feed - Introduce Welcome window with recent connections and enhance timeline structure - Refactor BrandBackdrop for improved visual consistency and clarity - Enhance session management and UI with recent connections and welcome window - Added hover submenu for improved menu navigation - Reopen closed tabs, and tree-wide actions beside the add menu - Visual EXPLAIN plans and Explain Analyze in the SQL console - Functions, procedures, sequences and materialized views in the explorer

item.title: TableGrip 1.0.0-beta.4
item.description: ### ✨ Features - Complete in the record console's language - Script console with completion, and results as an editable grid, JSON or tree - Add macOS menu bar support with settings and functionality - Enhance UpdatesPanel with improved UI and functionality

item.title: TableGrip 1.0.0-beta.3
item.description:
### ✨ Features - Browse Apache HBase through its REST server - Browse Nacos configurations and TDengine - Browse Weaviate, Milvus and Chroma - Browse rqlite and libSQL / Turso, SQLite over HTTP - Browse Consul's key-value store and ZooKeeper znodes - Browse Apache Kafka topics - Add Solr, Qdrant, RabbitMQ, InfluxDB 3 and Prometheus - Browse search, wide-column, document, time-series and graph engines - Support 15 more databases through their own JDBC drivers - Support Redshift, QuestDB, OceanBase, Doris, StarRocks and Presto - **www:** Show how many databases TableGrip supports - Review pending changes before submitting, and show database logos - Introduce the MCP server on the website, with its docs - **mcp:** Let AI apps use your connections over MCP - **updates:** Open the updater window as soon as Check for Updates is clicked - Translate the interface into Vietnamese and Chinese - **www:** Replace hero screenshot with an animated product demo - **www:** Refresh landing page sections, header and theme toggle - Support Oracle, Firebird, Trino and YugabyteDB - Introduce custom AppIcons and replace existing icons in ChartView and FixView
### 🐛 Bug Fixes - Name ZooKeeper and Consul tabs by path, and make re-runs of the server tests repeatable - Size SQL editor caret to the glyphs and centre it in the line
